configs/values-dev.yaml.summary: This file defines development-specific configuration values for the `ui` service. It manages deployment settings, including port assignments and ingress routing for the `cluster.green-lms.app` environment.

README.md.summary: This `README.md` serves as the project documentation, outlining the React and Vite configuration, including available plugins like `@vitejs/plugin-react` and `@vitejs/plugin-react-swc` for development.

Dockerfile.summary: This `Dockerfile` containerizes the application by installing dependencies, building the project for a specific environment, and defining the startup command to run the production server on port 3000.

package.json.summary: This `package.json` file manages dependencies, build scripts, and project configuration for the `lms-ui` frontend application, serving as the central manifest for development and production workflows.

server/index.js.summary: `server/index.js` initializes an Express server to serve static assets from the `dist` directory and applies `limiter` middleware to enforce request rate limits for the application.

configs/values-prod.yaml.summary: This file defines production-specific configuration values for the `ui` service. It manages deployment settings, including port assignments and ingress routing for the `green-lms.app` domain.

set-env-dev.sh.summary: `set-env-dev.sh` configures local development environment variables, establishing database, message broker, and runtime settings. It prepares the local system for running project services.

server/proxy.js.summary: `server/proxy.js` sets up an Express development server that proxies API requests to the Green-LMS cluster with CORS enabled. It runs the backend proxy middleware for the project.

server/package.json.summary: This file manages the backend package configuration, dependencies, and execution scripts. It orchestrates server startup and proxy tasks for the project.

src/components/Alerts/styled.js.summary: This file provides styling for alert notifications in the UI. It exports the `SAlert` styled component to render animated toast messages.

src/App.jsx.summary: This file serves as the application's root component, wrapping the UI with Redux state management, persistence, and theme providers. It exports the `App` component to render the main application structure.

src/components/Alerts/index.jsx.summary: This file renders temporary notification alerts retrieved from the global store. It exports the `Alert` component as default and the internal `AlertCard` function.
